name: gizza-ai/text-statistics
summary: Word/character/sentence stats + reading time for text.

tool.description: Analyze a block of text and return its statistics: characters (with and without spaces), words, sentences, paragraphs, lines, estimated reading time (200 wpm) and speaking time (130 wpm) in minutes, average word length, and average words per sentence. Runs locally — the text never leaves the device.
